  Readable gloss: "A town in the central hill country serving as a military gathering point. Judah defeated the Canaanite and Perizzite forces at Bezek and captured King Adoni-bezek there (Judges 1:4-5). Saul mustered the Israelite army at Bezek before relieving Jabesh-gilead from the Ammonite siege (1 Samuel 11:8). The site, possibly modern Khirbet Ibziq, lay on a route between the central highlands and the Jordan valley, making it strategically valuable for troop assembly. The location's name may relate to gravel or scattering."
